FAQ

What is a Bitcoin mixer?

A Bitcoin mixer or Bitcoin tumbler is a cryptocurrency anonymization service that breaks the link between your old and new address and makes it impossible to track your transactions in the Bitcoin network.

How does the Bitcoin tumbler work?

  • 1. You send your coins to our Bitcoin tumbler;
  • 2. your coins and other customers' coins are deposited in a secure, common pool and mixed;
  • 3. after mixing, you receive coins which are made up of other customers' coins and/or coins from the reserves of our system.

The result of the process is that the link between your old and new wallet addresses is broken, therefore giving you an anonymous, fresh start on the blockchain.
Why it is necessary to use a Bitcoin tumbler?

Cryptocurrencies are blockchain based. Blockchains are ongoing and public ledgers of events which record every single transaction that occurs over the cryptocurrency network.


The effect of this level of public information sharing is that any time you engage in a transaction (i.e. when you send or receive Bitcoin), the other party knows your wallet address and is therefore able to view all of your financial history, including the balance in your wallet. The other party will also be able to monitor your future transactions and can share your wallet address with others, including cybercriminals.


In order to avoid this and keep your personal anonymity and the anonymity of your cryptocurrency funds, you need to use Bitcoin tumbler to break the link between your old and new wallet address.

How safe and legal is it to use the Pancakeswapescrow.com Bitcoin Mixer?

Our service does not require any form of user registration, e-mail or personal data whatsoever. Therefore, you can rest assured that using the Pancakeswapescrow.com Bitcoin Mixer is not only completely safe, but legal as well.

How long does it take to mix my coins?

As soon as your coin arrives at our pool and the first miner confirmations are accepted, a new and completely untraceable set of coins originating from wallets unrelated with yours will be sent to your specified wallet(s) immediately or with a delay, depending on the delivery time settings you've chosen.

Which criteria make for the best Bitcoin tumbler?

The best Bitcoin tumbler anonymizes client's coins 100% in a way that is untraceable and resistant to sophisticated forms of blockchain analysis. It should also be safe, reliable, easy to use, and service fees should be reasonable and transparent to the client. Pancakeswapescrow.com is the only Bitcoin tumbler available which meets or exceeds all of the aforementioned criteria.

Can I create my own Bitcoin mixer?

You can easily and quickly create your own Bitcoin mixer using the Pancakeswapescrow.com API.

What is the difference between a Bitcoin tumbler and a Bitcoin mixer?

There is no difference between the two. They are two ways of saying the same thing, both refer to the process of creating anonymous, untraceable Bitcoin.
